scope: Existing scientific results only; no model recomputation.

metric_conventions.slope_half: absolute secant dtheta/d(x/H) at the same crossing
metric_conventions.broadness: first x/H where theta<0.1 minus first x/H where theta<0.9; discrete coordinates

csv_contract.empty_numeric_cell: Use status to distinguish unavailable values from a logged absent crossing.
csv_contract.case_VIII_secondary_parameter: tend is retained in runs metadata; CSV primary varying parameter is pA0.
csv_contract.no_crossing_scope: Only Model A literal NaN stdout values are labelled no_crossing. Model B NaN arrays are screened/unretained values with unknown raw cause.

sources.precision: Preserve each numeric literal as written; Case VIII repeated constants are source declarations, not new independent runs.
not_retained: B raw metrics overwritten by source-array NaN
